invite.title: Invite collaborators
invite.description: Share this room with a link that expires in 24 hours. Anyone with the link joins as an editor.
invite.notSaved: This project is not saved to the cloud yet, so there is no room to invite people to. Save it to the cloud first, then reopen this dialog.
invite.copyFailed: Your browser blocked copying. The link is selected for you — press Ctrl+C.
invite.expiresHint: Anyone with the link can join the room as an editor until it expires.
invite.ownerOnly: Only the project owner can invite collaborators and see the member list.
invite.error: Could not load this room. Please try again.
invite.removeFailed: Could not remove member. Please try again.

join.title: Join a collaboration room
join.lead: You were invited to a SQLLens room. Join to open it in your workspace.
join.missingToken: This link has no invite code. Ask the sender to create a new link.
join.signedOut: You need to sign in to join a room.
join.expired: This invite link has expired. Ask the room owner for a new link.
join.invalid: This invite link is invalid or the room was deleted.
join.forbidden: Your account is not allowed into this room.
join.unavailable: Could not reach the server. Please try again.
join.storage: This browser will not let SQLLens save the room. Turn off private browsing and try again.
join.joinedSaveFailed: You joined the room, but SQLLens could not save a local copy on this device. Try again or open the workspace.
join.joinedStorageFailed: You joined the room, but this browser blocked saving a local copy. Turn off private browsing and try again, or open the workspace.
join.failed: Could not join the room. Please try again.

baton.blockedTooltipUnknown: Another collaborator holds the run baton

p2p.natWarning: Best experienced on the same LAN or Open NAT.
p2p.batonReturned: Run baton was automatically returned to the room owner ({holder}).
